Sites = every `call [vtreg+off]` in full_export snapshot; slot=off/4 in the vtable vtreg holds (per-class primary-table numbering of slot_param_groups). vptr_off is informational only (v3 R2/R3: MSVC MI secondary tables carry the base's own primary numbering — verified AbstractClass secondary 0x7E1F34 — so off/4 is the correct slot number regardless of primary/secondary/untraced vptr origin). Receiver discipline unchanged: non-call ecx def between nearest push and call (thiscall k-numbering integrity); push collection backward from call (k=0 nearest, this excluded; barriers call/ret/j*|loop/label/esp-adjust; cap 80), capped at family nstk (determined path) or slot max nstk (multi-root path). Attachment v3: (a) binds-determined (receiver-anchored callee in occ at site slot, unique root) — full emission (obs + eq edges); (b) mono slot (single root across group universe at that slot) — full emission, NO vptr0 requirement (single root covers every table's slot numbering); (c) R1 multi-root slot-direct-connect — receiver class unknown => every occupant of that slot number is a possible callee => str/const push observations AND-merge onto ALL arity-compatible roots (family nstk >= collected push count; superset attachment only tightens the per-entity AND => sound); eq edges NOT emitted on the multi-root path (an equality must stand independently true; multi-root edges would be conditional — counted in mr_skip_edge_kind_*). AND-merge per GS: CP = all-immediate AND no occupant CALL_ARG param edge at (fn,k); SP = all-string AND classifiable occupant CALL_ARG origins all strings; mixed discarded.
